answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-identity wharf: every new agent must lock a deposit before it can dock, and its voting weight climbs a slow ridge over epochs of sustained uptime instead of starting at full power. Scarce quorum slots sit on a jetty that only opens once that history exists, so a Sybil pays the bond per puppet and waits out the ridge before any of them earns influence, while the reward stays capped.
